q: On the regular payroll, been here five years, fully from home: how much time off am I building up each month, and how much can I still be holding in January?

Based on your profile — **regular payroll (type E1)**, **five years of tenure (T3)**, **fully remote (site L4)** — the current accrual table (in force from 2026-01-01) gives:

- **Monthly accrual:** 0.62 days per month
- **Carry-over limit (max you can be holding into January):** 13 days

So each month you build up 0.62 days of leave, and the most you're allowed to carry over into the new year (January) is 13 days — any unapproved excess beyond that is forfeited, though an unavoidable excess can be claimed separately with written justification.
